spanish: E hizo el altar del incienso, maderas de shitím; codo su largo y codo su ancho, cuadrado, y dos codos su alto; desde él fueron sus cuernos.

findings.issue: מִמֶּנּוּ is tagged preposition + 1st common plural suffix (from us); Spanish «él» is 3rd masculine singular (from him) and changes person.

notes: Remaining clauses match the tokens: he made the incense altar, shittim woods, one cubit its length and one cubit its width, square, two cubits its height, its horns were.
